decision.rationale: The official UBC Pop Culture Cluster explicitly supports academic and public-facing scholarship and identifies its location as UBC Vancouver. The homepage supplies useful research-project descriptions, public events and a fellowship call, rather than personal, duplicate or authentication-only content.
evidence: https://pop-culture.arts.ubc.ca/ | 703959b691afd8df052ae7d87d191f9c4c64d50ea3d1787ba282e1e47eee3699 | The Pop Culture Cluster supports academic and public-facing scholarship on popular media and popular culture at UBC.
https://pop-culture.arts.ubc.ca/ | 703959b691afd8df052ae7d87d191f9c4c64d50ea3d1787ba282e1e47eee3699 | The UBC Pop Culture Cluster is located at UBC Vancouver
https://pop-culture.arts.ubc.ca/ | 703959b691afd8df052ae7d87d191f9c4c64d50ea3d1787ba282e1e47eee3699 | Call for Critical Play Fellows

rules.rationale: The homepage advertises a fellowship application call for graduate students, faculty, game designers, educators and community members.

fallback.rationale: The cluster's stated purpose is academic and public-facing scholarship on popular media and culture, illustrated by ongoing collaborative research projects.
